name: Burial Hymn
body:
School necromancy; Level bard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You play or sing a song of death and remembrance causing all undead to feel the call of their grave. All undead who fail their saving throw are staggered, mindless undead do not gain a saving throw.

Undead that are already staggered are unable to move but may still use their standard action.
